reviews.title: Became too profit driven, deleting the app
reviews.text:
Once an app gets too big, the app starts to lose focus of the app’s main purpose. That’s what happened to Forest. 

It used to be so straight forward, which is just to track your study time and you get a digital tree in your forest for studying. Now, it’s all about trying to make you buy coins, pop ups after pop ups, and trying to get you to get this type of tree and plant. It’s so silly to me. Do they not know the demographics of their users? 

Are people really paying for “coins”? And for what? JUST focus on studying and passing your class/exams. 

The last straw for me was the app removing the total focus  time of the day on the main screen. what?? That’s literally the whole point of a study app…. To track your total time spent studying. 

I know they see their growing user base and now all they think about is how to extract money from each of them. It’s literally just a study app.. what kind of big money do y’all really think you will eventually make? 

Farewell. I’ll be using another study app from now on.

reviews.title: Retro User
reviews.text:
I first downloaded this app about 6 years ago and used it with a friend. We both loved it; it was a simple way to keep us both off our phones and on task. Each of us even bought a subscription. 

These past few months, the UI updates and AI integration have made this app so, so clunky. It breaks my heart to say that it's an eyesore now. The designs feel so much less simple and human-made. Clicking through a series of prompts makes the planting feature less efficient to use. 

Please, please offer some settings to help us go back to the way things were. Cut the AI garbage and cumbersome UI. For an app that espouses the value of getting off screen and going out into the world to do good (planting trees irl, getting your work done and be a functioning person), the AI integration is such a big disappointment. 

I've been actively searching for better apps to use. Please Forest, listen to those of us posting here and online.

reviews.title: Stop asking for money
reviews.text:
Stop monetizing everything. Stop pushing the subscription onto everyone. I already paid you, I’m not giving you more. And a lot of users are probably students who should be pressured into paying for features that should be free. Trend analysis as tags aren’t exactly special features that should be behind a paywall. 

It’s so obvious that you only care for the people who pay the subscription. Everything good goes to them. They get bonus daily tasks for gems. They get new trees. I have thousands of coins and absolutely nothing to spend them on because you’re only focusing on things for your subscription. And that’s after the shop got “fixed.” Which it didn’t, not really. You got rid of bundles, which I was saving for since they were a little discounted. You have to hope you’re lucky and get a gem tree that you want when you finally saved enough. We wanted more trees, not whatever this is. 

Just stop. You’ve pushed so many people away from your app because you keep ruining it. You made it take so long just to get to the Home Screen after a session. My app glitched on me today and the alert that the session stopped and rewards came an hour after I stopped it. You made an entire event on a feature that so many people couldn’t find at first since finding it isn’t intuitive. 

Please, for the love of God, stop making this app worse. Stop asking for money when people have already paid.

reviews.title: 5 year user leaving, can’t recommend
reviews.text:
Was a loyal user of Forest for 5 years, I paid for the app and loved it for 4 of those years

The app took a new direction around a year ago, it moved from a one-time fee to a freemium model and this was the beginning of the slop

The app moved from incredibly stable to receiving regular forced updates that introduced bugs. The team introduced more trees along with daily login events and timed events. This completely defeats the point of getting off your phone and focusing. When your focus app needs you to log in daily and rewards you with cosmetics, it is no longer a focus app, it’s part of the problem.

Under the most recent update they removed the ability to configure “favourites” which were easy to pick combinations of tags and trees, completely gutting my use of the app and violating their promise of retaining pro features that users paid for.

Do not trust this company, do not download this app. It will demand your attention and focus on your screen, it will not help you focus on other things. It’s a shame as it was a great app for many years.

They should’ve left the app as it was and paid for the marketing of a new app, but instead they chose to predate their own user base in lieu of taking the risk of launching a new app.

reviews.title: New Update Very Frustrating
reviews.text:
I’ve used and enjoyed this app for years, but this new update made sometime in September or October of 2026 has significantly reduced my satisfaction and compelled me to write this review. 

In some apparent effort to make the app something more profitable or inspiring more engagement, they have added all sorts of “events” and continued to focus on the coin shop. Worst of all, though, is they changed the UI so now I have to tap roughly 4 times to exit a timer I just set, when it used to be once. The app also no longer displays my total focus time for the day without having to tap 3-4 times to go see it on a separate screen. Why? They’ve also made many overtures to get me to “relax” as if this is a meditation app or something.

I bought this years ago just to time my focus and track my progress, as well as have a motivator in the form of the tree. Please just keep this simple or give me the option to strip away the excessive features that don’t serve that purpose and make this app more convoluted. I will have to move to a different method in the future, otherwise, and that saddens me since I’ve used this for 5+ years without issue until now.

reviews.title: New UI Has Some Pros, But I Haaaaate the Popups

They changed the user interface today.

What I don’t like:
- Annoying popups flash across my screen when I finish planting a tree and want to back to the home screen! This app is supposed to reduce distractions, not create them. 
- Some of the trees displayed are not purchasable in the store, yet clicking on them still takes me to the store. 
- There are still very few tag colors. Other people and I specifically submitted a feedback request asking for more tag colors, but there are still just a handful. 

What I feel mixed about:
- The trees bounce up and down, and the coin icon shimmers. It’s kind of cool, but also very distracting.



Edit; I changed my review to one star. They’re now deleting trees from the regular store and making you rebuy them for a much higher price only on certain days when they happen to appear in the temporary store that refreshes daily. This is so stupid. It’s clear that they’re creating a scarcity mindset to pressure people to check the app often. That goes against the whole point of making an app to get you off your phone!

reviews.title: Downhill Slide
reviews.text: I’ve used this app since 2016 and have been a huge advocate for it since early days. While I can’t think of any period of time in the past decade where the Forest app has maintained excellent stability free of glitches, the overall usefulness of the app has allowed me to look past that. In the past 12-18 months, things have been going downhill. The devs keep pushing out excessive updates that prioritize gamification in the app and focus on money-making capacity of the app. All the while, stability in the app for users like myself and my friends has decreased and glitches have increased to the point of a non-functional app. Sharing session links, planting together, and Deep Focus mode are all useless now with the rollout of a new UI and the retirement of “classic” mode. It’s a real shame. I’ve accumulated over 275 days of planting time in this app, the majority of which were logged in Plant Together mode with friends. I’ll be sad to leave the app and my land of virtual trees behind, but it may be the natural course of things if the devs continue to ignore prioritization of the function and stability of the Forest app.

reviews.title: I love this app, but…
reviews.text:
I really love this app. I’ve been using it for years and have found it very helpful to focus and track my writing time. However, since the introduction of focus challenge I have been annoyed by the implementation. My biggest issue is the fact that I have to reset my focus timer each time I want to “plant a tree” for the challenge. If I do 2 hours in the app, it says I planted 4 trees in my forest but only one tree for the daily challenge. If the daily challenge says “plant any tree 4 times” I have to start and stop my focus timer four times (once every 30 minutes) in order for the trees to count. Why? The fact that I have to interrupt my focus time to stop and reset in order to achieve the daily challenge is ridiculous. It’s actually the opposite of focus, enough that I may have to switch to a different app because it is distracting me trying to keep my trees and focus time to match. 

Please fix this. Make it so that when I focus for a number of hours, the daily challenge counts my trees planted, not by the number of times I started focusing. It feels like a bug, but it’s been present since the focus challenge released. Thanks!

Also the fact that you have a basic track and a pro track for the focus challenges while, AGAIN completely ignoring those who paid for the app.

reviews.title: Fix this
reviews.text: The tree should not die if you close the app by accident. Happened too many times. Fix it already pls.

reviews.title: Terrible interface after recent update
reviews.text: Harder to use and regularly freezes since the recent update. The whole point is that I should not have to focus on what I’m doing - not think about the app & deal with it crashing. Counterproductive.

reviews.title: Update is unusable
reviews.text: App gets stuck at the end of a countdown, only way to move it along is force close it, relaunch the app and hope the timer didn’t lose progress. Such a shame as this was a really good app. The latest update has killed it.

reviews.title: Glitchy Interface and overcommercialization
reviews.text:
I’ve used the forest app for over a decade, and even purchased the paid version, in which time I’ve gotten tens of friends to join and have used it religiously throughout college, grad school applications, and entering the workforce. I loved this app. 

I’m incredibly disappointed in the direction the app has gone, pushing a bigger and more expensive paid option and updating the UI in a way that is glitchy, lags, and no longer tracks time accurately. When I focus longer than the set time, despite having my settings to track extended time, it doesn’t record it. The app also crashes at least once a week or takes 30s-1 min just to switch pages. I’m also sick of having Plus pushed onto me - I have already paid for Forest previously and don’t want my app to continue trying to sell me stuff. This is also not even to mention that I can no longer plant trees in real life or make any kind of real world impact. 

I will stop using Forest if the glitches and over commercialization do not get fixed.

reviews.title: Disappointing Update
reviews.text: Not a fan of the update honestly it feels like we’re being forced to spend more time on the app with enforced/assumed break times, the selection process of trees and time doesn’t feel satisfying and I actually want to stop using the app because of this. Why change something if it’s not broke? At the very least give users an option to stick with the original format/design.

reviews.title: Did you just move the ability to customise allowed app list to subscription-only?
reviews.text: Mind you this was a paid app initially 7+ years ago. Custom Allowed App List was a core feature. Otherwise what’s the point of the non-sub paid version?

reviews.title: REALLY dislike the new UI
reviews.text:
I really miss the radial time select, and I hate that my trees are no longer ordered by last used. I used to cycle through plants, choosing the one I haven’t chosen before in the longest amount of time, to keep my forest a balanced mix of species. Now, even when trying to sort by recently used, it’s not giving me that actual list, because I know some of them that should be close together that aren’t. I would like the radial time back instead of having to click through another menu, and I’d like an actual list organized by the order I’ve selected plants in.

I don’t understand why this app (which at its best has been great!!) feels the need to keep reinventing itself without any seeming regard for actual user experience — it feels like someone’s just got it in their head that they NEED to switch things up regularly. 

Given the app developer’s propensity for AI, in both their chatGPT developer responses and their other AI app, I’m wondering if at an upper level, someone is prompting an AI for ideas and then implementing them because AI said so. I don’t entirely trust that these are human-led poor decisions, just because some of them are SO baffling (literally why would you change the dial function to a pop up menu?? that’s more clicks and you can’t easily see what the plant looks like at each time any more. reviews.title: Where is my stuff?
reviews.text: So I have spent some time over the years using the app on and off, unlocked some bits, decided to focus again only to be met with a sub paywall and all of my progress lost.

reviews.title: Awful visual update
reviews.text: It’s no so much more difficult to plant trees, why is the timer a completely separate screen instead of using the wheel? Can’t find favourites either

reviews.title: Useless app
reviews.text: Totally useless app. It mostly just gets in the way and distracts you. Unless you're looking to waste £5.99 a month on a fancy timer, save your money.

reviews.title: Used to be great
reviews.text: Now the “focus again” option is replaced with a link to a spammy “take a break” screen that’s hard to get out of. Totally ruined the focus immersion and therefore effectiveness. Such a shame - had been super helpful for many years until bought out and overly commercialised.

reviews.title: Becoming worse with monetising
reviews.text:
I have been using forest for years and loved the daily focus challenges. However hate the new ‘Plus Bonus’ item that’s added, right at the top of the list which you can’t tick off/claim unless you’re a monthly subscriber. Makes the whole thing so unsatisfying to use. 
Subscriptions are the bane of my existence and now it’s too irritating to use the app. I hope this feature is removed but I’m not very hopeful as there’s been a lot of new monetising features added recently.

reviews.title: When an app loses its purpose
reviews.text: Born for productivity, now it makes you do challenges to win coins and other tokens, using which you can get more types of trees and other nice stuff. Result? You get addicted to planting trees and checking your progress. And your focus just doesn’t matter anymore.

reviews.title: Used to be great, but now not worth it
reviews.text: They’ve added a subscription charge even though it was a one-time payment originally. STAY AWAY.

reviews.title: Plagued by In-App Purchases Now…
reviews.text: I bought Forest maybe two years ago at the recommendation of a friend. I think it’s a great tool for keeping me off my phone, especially when I need to focus on something or have short intervals of time away from my phone. But after redownloading it recently after a period of not using it, there are so many more in-app purchases that restrict the way the app is used and make it hard to incentivize using it. I liked Forest because it was a pay-once kind of app, and not subscription based the way most things are nowadays. But now in order to cultivate any sort of beautiful forest or garden on this app, you have to pay exorbitant amounts of money for fake trees and shrubs (any amount of money is exorbitant for fake trees and shrubs on an app i’ve already paid for 🙄). Unfortunately Forest has caved to the same sort of capitalist greed that every other app has. If anyone has any other productivity apps that work well and won’t cost me an arm and a leg please let me know!

reviews.title: Bug monete
reviews.text:
App utilissima e ogni aggiornamento lo trovo più dinamico. 
Il problema però che spesso la sfida del giorno si azzera, nonostante il tempo trascorso. È capitato diverse volte :-/ . Questo non consente di monetizzare, è fatto di proposito?!

reviews.title: Assurdo
reviews.text: Dopo aver pagato l’app, ha smesso di funzionare, mi ha cancellato tutti i progressi, e mi ha attivato un account gratuito…

reviews.title: Critical bug
reviews.text: I’ve been using the app for about two years but in the past few weeks, cancelling a revision session before it ends will give you the full time, so overcounts significantly how many minutes you have. Further sometimes it may just add 100 minutes or so, I had something like 180 minutes added despite the maximum being 2 hours. It’s really hard to justify me using this app and I may have to switch to another platform if it’s not resolved.

reviews.title: Not worth it at all
reviews.text: First I paid for the app and it was fine. It took really long to get enough points to plant actual trees or buy stuff- AND if you wanted to buy different trees to plant with points you couldn’t plant actual trees because you wouldn’t have any coins left. The app was fine and did its job though. BUT THEN - it got rid of all my past studying times, made me log in with an email, and everything became ‘premium’ that I had to pay  MORE ACTUAL MONEY for.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: I’ve been using forest for four years through education. I’ve loved it however one year my garden got reset. I had completed 2000 hours in 2025 and that went to 0. I lost my plants which took countless hours to collect and I’m now stuck using the generic ones. I’ve requested support in app but they haven’t helped me and I think a bad review will hopefully make them do something about it.

reviews.title: Tutto a pagamento
reviews.text: Grazie mille per rendere tutto a pagamento oggi giorno. Non si può nemmeno mettere in pausa il timer che bisogna pagare. Vi ringrazio molto cercherò un’altra applicazione o a sto punto inizio a tenere traccia dello studio manualmente.

reviews.title: Non si fa così
reviews.text: App comprata anni fa, oggi la riapro per utilizzarla e scopro che tantissime funzioni richiedono ancora altri soldi. Non è onesto nei confronti di chi ha creduto nel progetto.

reviews.title: The pause button update is so stupid please make it premium or something
reviews.text: If the company made pro or premium without having the pause button I would definitely buy it. PAUSE BUTTON IS THE MOST STUPID THING EVER

reviews.title: Terrible now they’ve made it free
reviews.text: This used to be a really phenomenal app and perfect for studying as an undergraduate student. It used to be really helpful for focusing and also helped with motivation and planting more trees. However now they’re clearly trying to squeeze even more money out of users in the pursuit of further profit. I paid for this app rather than the many others that are free, because it explicitly did not have ads and all features would be accessible once you purchase it. Now however, they’ve shifted to making it free but with yet another subscription service meant to harass people into buying it. There’s now ads that make the app buggy, and constant efforts to try and get you to spend more on it. This is extremely frustrating and dishonest particularly to those of us who have paid to download it. At first they made us into a “pro” service with no ads but now they’ve introduced a “plus” group and have started to spam the pro group with ads to get them to purchase the plus and subscribe to yet another racketeering scheme. Absolutely disgraceful behaviour. Do not waste your money on this and go download one of the many other productivity apps where at the very least you know what you’re paying for.

reviews.title: Delusa, amareggiata
reviews.text:
Ho scaricato nuovamente Forest dopo qualche tempo.
Sono rimasta molto molto delusa.
In passato ho scelto di pagare per quest’app e vedere che ora tutti i suoi vantaggi sono disponibili solo con l’abbonamento mi ha lasciato con l’amaro in bocca.
Passerò ad altre applicazioni che mi permettano di concentrarmi ed usare la musica contemporaneamente.

reviews.title: wth?
reviews.text: it unlogged me out of forest and now it even lost all my proggress

reviews.title: Timer per la pausa
reviews.text: Ho forest da diversi anni, ora con il nuovo aggiornamento hanno tolto la possibilità di mettere un semplicissimo timer per la pausa sostituendolo con un’impostazione per la meditazione, risulta molto fastidioso in quanto alla prima sessione di studio devi saltare tutti i passaggi della meditazione prima di poter impostare un semplice timer, sarà forse un modo per obbligare le persone a effettuare un futuro abbonamento?

reviews.title: Avete rovinato tutto
reviews.text: Una volta pagavi solo l’acquisto dell’app per avere tutte le funzioni ed era bellissima così. Ora per fare tutto bisogna avere un abbonamento mensile. Un altro abbonamento inutile per una app che un abbonamento non serve. Anche per piantare i veri alberi bisogna avere un abbonamento mensile. Spero che ritorniate sui vostri passi e ascoltate i vostri clienti storici come me che apprezzavano davvero come era l’app una volta senza abbonamento. Ditemi voi se è possibile avere un abbonamento per tutto! Soprattutto per questa bellissima app che portava un messaggio semplice e bellissimo.

reviews.title: ads?
reviews.text: paid for it and now they want to put ads on it, crazy..

reviews.title: Disappointed with subscription model
reviews.text:
I’ll start by saying that I’ve found this app really useful throughout post secondary education and during university, particularly when faced with deadlines or looming exams. 

I found the main appeal of this app was that by working on my studies, I’d also be able to plant real trees. I paid for this feature, and it’s now been taken away and put behind a paywall. I also paid to not see ads (as I would do in other free alternatives to this app), and now Ill be seeing those aswell, which is actually more distracting than just using a timer. 
I would not recommend paying to subscribe to this app. It was good when it was a one off payment and the original features were included in that price, but recently I’ve been really disappointed by the greed of the developers damaging the apps utility.

reviews.title: Money greed
reviews.text: Once a good app destroyed by developers' greed. Everything once free after you bought the app in appstore is now a feature only available to monthly subscribers. Screw it, there are tons of free productivity apps and this greedy policy of yours is why I won't ever use this app. Hope you are happy. Can't imagine what a fool pays monthly subscription for an app that just doesn't allow you to open apps😂😂😂

reviews.title: Taking away free features
reviews.text: I liked this app some time ago but they've become very money-hungry lately. Free features like custom tags have become subscription locked. Pathetic.
